contentHtml:
Bathroom renovation cost in Gurgaon depends mostly on the specification you choose. A full renovation of a typical 40–50 sq ft bathroom costs about ₹1.3–2.8 lakh at mid-range specification, ₹3–5.5 lakh at premium specification, and ₹6 lakh or more for a luxury bathroom with imported fittings and stone. A cosmetic refresh without breaking tiles can cost under ₹1 lakh.

The bathroom is the most expensive room in a home per square foot. Demolition, waterproofing, plumbing, tiling and fittings all fit into 40 sq ft, and each one needs a different skilled trade. This guide breaks the cost down line by line so you can plan a realistic budget for your Gurgaon home. For whole-home budgets, see our guide to interior design cost in Gurgaon.

How much does a bathroom renovation cost in Gurgaon?

A full gut renovation of a 40–50 sq ft bathroom in Gurgaon ranges from ₹70,000 at basic specification to ₹6 lakh or more for luxury. Here is what each tier usually includes:

TierCost (40–50 sq ft bathroom)What you get
Basic₹70,000 – ₹1.1 lakhCeramic tiles, standard Indian-brand fittings, exposed or partly concealed plumbing
Mid-range₹1.3 – 2.8 lakhVitrified tiles, concealed plumbing, wall-hung or rimless WC, glass partition, vanity
Premium₹3 – 5.5 lakhLarge-format porcelain, premium Indian or entry imported fittings, rain shower, niche lighting
Luxury₹6 lakh+Natural marble, imported sanitaryware, thermostatic shower, custom vanity, smart WC (see our spa-style bathroom ideas)

Indicative Delhi NCR ranges for a full gut renovation, materials and labour included, November 2026.

Two things push Gurgaon prices above the national average. Skilled labour in Delhi NCR costs more than in smaller cities, and Gurgaon homeowners tend to choose a higher fitting specification, especially in premium societies on Golf Course Road and Dwarka Expressway.

Bathroom renovation cost breakdown, line by line

Tiles and sanitaryware are usually the largest costs, followed by plumbing. This is what each line typically costs in Gurgaon:

ItemTypical cost (Gurgaon, 2026)Notes
Demolition & debris removal₹8,000 – ₹20,000Tile chipping, old fittings out, debris disposal per society rules
Waterproofing₹8,000 – ₹25,000Cementitious or membrane system, floor plus walls in the wet zone
Plumbing (pipes + labour)₹15,000 – ₹30,000 (mid-range)₹40,000 – ₹80,000 for premium concealed systems
Tiles (supply)₹60 – ₹150 per sq ft (mid-range)₹150 – ₹350 premium porcelain; marble ₹200 – ₹800+
Tile laying labour₹35 – ₹80 per sq ft₹80 – ₹150 per sq ft for large-format tiles
WC₹6,000 – ₹80,000Floor-mounted to wall-hung with concealed cistern
Shower₹2,000 – ₹60,000Basic overhead set to rain shower; thermostatic up to ₹1.5 lakh
Faucets & CP fittings set₹9,000 – ₹15,000 (budget)Mid and premium brands cost several times more
Vanity, mirror, glass partition₹20,000 – ₹1 lakh+Depends on size, stone top and glass thickness
Electrical, lighting & exhaust₹8,000 – ₹25,000Moisture-rated lights, geyser point, exhaust fan

Sanitaryware and fittings attract 18% GST. Check whether your quote includes it.

Why tiles and fittings swing the budget most

Floor area is fixed, but the specification is not. The same 40 sq ft bathroom can cost twice as much on brand choice alone. Tiles range from about ₹25 per sq ft for basic ceramic to well over ₹800 per sq ft for imported marble, and fittings range from a ₹6,000 floor-mounted WC to an ₹80,000 wall-hung unit.

Why small bathrooms cost more per sq ft

A 35 sq ft bathroom needs the same WC, shower and basin as a 70 sq ft one, and plumbers and tilers still charge minimum visits. So a smaller bathroom costs less in total but more per sq ft. Plan your budget per fixture, not per sq ft.

What makes bathroom renovation cost more in Gurgaon?

Hard water, society rules, tired waterproofing in older homes, and summer heat and humidity all add to a Gurgaon bathroom budget:

  • Hard water: Gurgaon's hard water leaves white scale on glass, chrome and grout. Budget for anti-scale glass coating, good-quality chrome finishes, and if needed a water softener on the geyser line.
  • Society rules: Most high-rise societies limit noisy work to set hours, ask for a refundable deposit and control debris removal. This can stretch timelines and add small costs.
  • Waterproofing in older homes: Builder floors and 15–20-year-old flats in DLF Phases and Sushant Lok often have tired sunken-slab waterproofing. Redoing it properly is the single most important spend: a leak into the flat below costs far more to fix later.
  • Heat and humidity: Summer heat and monsoon humidity are hard on cheap laminates and MDF. Use waterproof plywood or acrylic for vanities, and choose moisture-resistant finishes. Our guide to materials for Gurgaon's climate covers the options.

How long does a bathroom renovation take?

A full bathroom renovation takes about 2–3 weeks per bathroom, including a 24–48 hour water-ponding test before tiling.

StageTypical duration
Demolition & debris removal1 – 2 days
Plumbing & electrical rework2 – 3 days
Waterproofing + water-ponding test3 – 4 days (incl. 24 – 48 hour test)
Tiling4 – 6 days
Fittings, vanity, glass & finishing2 – 4 days
TotalAbout 2 – 3 weeks per bathroom

Renovating several bathrooms together saves time, because the trades move from one to the next without separate mobilisation.

5 ways to avoid a bathroom renovation budget overrun

Most overruns come from changes made after work starts and from problems found during demolition. These five steps prevent them:

  1. Fix the fitting list before work starts. Changing the WC or shower type after plumbing is done means breaking new tiles.
  2. Never cut corners on waterproofing. Ask for a water-ponding test before tiling, and get the waterproofing warranty in writing.
  3. Buy 10% extra tiles. Cutting wastage and future repairs need matching tiles, and batches change in shade.
  4. Get an itemised quote. Each line should name the brand, model and quantity. A lump-sum "bathroom package" hides the real specification. Our guide to comparing interior design quotations shows what to check.
  5. Keep a 10–15% contingency. Old homes often reveal hidden pipe damage or a weak slab only after demolition.

faqs.question: How much does a bathroom renovation cost in Gurgaon?
faqs.answer: A full renovation of a 40–50 sq ft bathroom in Gurgaon typically costs ₹1.3–2.8 lakh at mid-range specification and ₹3–5.5 lakh at premium specification. Luxury bathrooms with imported fittings and natural stone start at about ₹6 lakh.

faqs.question: How much does a small bathroom renovation cost?
faqs.answer: A small 30–40 sq ft bathroom usually costs about ₹70,000–₹2 lakh to renovate fully, depending on tiles and fittings. It costs less in total than a large bathroom but more per sq ft, because it needs the same fixtures and minimum labour.

faqs.question: What is the most expensive part of a bathroom renovation?
faqs.answer: Tiles and sanitaryware are usually the largest costs, followed by plumbing. The brand of fittings you choose can double the total budget for the same size of bathroom.

faqs.question: Is bathroom renovation cost in Gurgaon higher than in Delhi?
faqs.answer: Costs are broadly similar across Delhi NCR. Gurgaon projects often end up higher because homeowners in premium societies choose higher-end fittings, and society rules on work hours can extend the timeline.

faqs.question: Can I renovate a bathroom without breaking tiles?
faqs.answer: Yes. A cosmetic refresh replaces fittings, the vanity, the mirror and lighting, and can re-grout or overlay tiles. It costs much less, but it will not fix leaks or old plumbing. If there is seepage, a full renovation with new waterproofing is needed.
